provenance.scope: Development-only native PCM/ASR experiment. No false slope, but a nonzero correction is applied to the aligned utterance-boundary reference. No proof of absence of degradation, independent corpus, production controller or audible playback.

report.reference: fixture SRT timings, not precise acoustic-onset ground truth
report.activationReference: Every sampled playback position from activation, including the acquisition interval. Accuracy after acquisition and acquisition latency are separate gates.
report.trackingReference: Correlated playback-time samples after first lock, including unknown regions at zero automatic delay. Ideal fixture transform, not independent acoustic annotations.
